description.text: The other sixth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Silver Lance on 23 April 2021, with Pokémon from The Crown Tundra. Jet-Black Spirit holds Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX and Zeraora V, a Rapid Strike card that can also hit a Benched Pokémon for 160 damage, with Celebi VMAX, Metagross VMAX and Blissey V and the Supporters Caitlin, Agatha, Peonia and Siebold. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Electrode, Fog Crystal, Echoing Horn and Psychic Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Chilling Reign in June 2021, and some in Evolving Skies in August 2021.
